before.image_prompt_horizontal:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE finished narrative illustration, not a contact sheet, not a three-panel comic, not an identity sheet.
API composition from approved visual Bible references. References are supporting inputs, not images to copy as a grid. Preserve specified character identities, clothing, age, matte paper material and landscape language; stage a NEW coherent scene.
MATERIAL LOCK: Colombian highland world of matte cut-paper craft. Broad flat cut surfaces, visible paper edges, folds, overlapping distant layers, real shallow cast shadows between paper planes. Human faces are tiny almost-flat paper silhouettes, NOT clay dolls, sculpted portraits, smooth CGI skin or photoreal skin. Water, cloud, mist and lightning are all PAPER SHAPES. Fog is broad flat white cutouts, never cotton, wool tufts, realistic smoke or translucent vapor. Earth is continuous layered paper relief, no exposed display base, table, plinth, diorama frame, grids, floating rectangular boards or stone grit. Simplify figures; enrich environmental relationships.
Narrative lock: Nasa–Paeces, El Trueno, first account attributed to Martin Kuskue via Bernal 1953 / Villa Posse 1993. Do not fuse with Rosario Iko, Justo Muse or Juan Petins variants. This is editorial adaptation, not a cultural certification or exact map. Do not portray ethnic adversaries, corpses, abduction, drowning, a battle or universal ethnic costume. No modern symbols, copied sacred motifs, invented glyphs, crowns, gold hats, halos, giant deity face in sky or other myths' protagonists.
ZERO text, letters, captions, labels, watermark, logos or border in the image. ONE view, edge-to-edge full artwork.

Input images by order: Image 1 P01 character identity, use ONLY his elderly human state; Image 2 C01 supporting sabedores, use ONLY its leftmost man and blue-shawl woman; Image 3 L03 setting/material/depth reference.
Primary request: A cinematic WIDE ENVIRONMENTAL scene of the elderly Trueno on a high rocky ridge speaking to two medical elders below him, telling them they can now clear the land; his retreat toward remote water lies ahead. The three people are SMALL fully clothed figures within a much larger mountainous landscape. Keep P01 gray hair, broad plain plant-fiber tan hat, heavy black cape, muted charcoal clothes. Two C01 listeners have plain modest bags and one plain staff, no ritual performance. Elder faces are distant, not individualized portraits.
Scene: a narrow ridge traversing steep close paper cliffs, much lower valleys and distant blue-green ridges. Trueno stands on a high paper ledge at right middle distance and extends an open advising hand toward the listeners on the lower path. ALL three full bodies visible, no human foreground close-up. The ridge continues away into mist toward a SMALL distant dark lagoon; water is NOT foreground ocean.
Concrete prodigy: broad storm-cloud PAPER layers align and gather toward the sweep of the old man's dark cape, making the atmosphere feel continuous with his departure; a few restrained forked pale-paper lightning cuts stay behind the distant mountains. This visual correspondence is an editorial metaphor, not a deity costume or a beam from a staff. Land and cloud participate without giant people.
Camera: distant elevated oblique establishing view, with an entire ridge segment between viewer and subjects. Human height around one sixth of frame height or smaller. Foreground paper plants and ledge anchor depth, background crosses many atmospheric layers. Left portion lower contrast for possible later editorial overlay, but no blank panel or empty beige block. Rich olive, muted ochre, storm charcoal and blue-green mountain paper; soft contrasting atmospheric light.

Input images by order: Image 1 C02 authorities, use ONLY its TOP ROW woman in green shawl and older man in blue-gray ruana; Image 2 U01 object reference, use ONLY plain dark chonta staff; absolutely omit its gold hat, bag and herb bundle; Image 3 V01 lagoon environment/material.
Primary request: A NEW vertical narrative scene, night at Vichaguau, two old cabildo authorities cooling their plain staffs in the small highland lagoon. This is not a crop or repetition of a ridge scene.
Two fully clothed adults stand on a shallow irregular shore at lower-middle frame: C02 green-shawl woman with full dark skirt, C02 older blue-gray-ruana man with beige ankle trousers and simple sandals. One staff per person, EXACTLY TWO staffs, each continuously and clearly held by its owner's hands, angled modestly forward, lower tip visibly entering the near dark-blue lagoon water. Do not stand on water. Keep both full bodies and feet on paper ground. A small crouch/forward lean makes dipping readable without close portrait scale.
Concrete action: small concentric layered BLUE PAPER ripple arcs appear exactly where the two staff tips meet the flat cut-paper surface. The ripples are ordinary material translation of touching water, no glowing portal, beam, ritual diagram or prescription.
A SMALL high mountain lagoon occupies middle ground, enclosed close steep paper ridges. Broad thin white-paper fog strata hover across distance and dim indigo sky. A visible night approach path enters from foreground to shore. People around one sixth of image height, environmental full view, foreground leaf silhouettes, plenty of vertical depth. Subtle pale sky reflection is made from a few flat light-blue paper shapes, never photographic sparkling water. No visible Trueno, no additional people, no shrine, no building, no gold object, no moon-face.

FINAL STAGING CORRECTION: Both authorities must remain on DRY PAPER LAND, not wading, not standing on water or ripple rings. Show EXACTLY FOUR FEET, all planted on a broad clearly visible continuous dry ochre-paper shore ledge that extends from the lower-left foreground. The water edge is in front of their feet; a visible strip of dry land separates each shoe from the water. Each person holds ONE plain staff sloping forward away from their body, its lower tip extends beyond the dry ledge and enters water. Two small paper ripple rings under STAFF TIPS ONLY, none under feet. Keep people moderately small within the environmental scene, full bodies, correct clothing. Do not make the shore so narrow that a sandal overlaps blue water. This corrects staging only; retain night lagoon and approved visual language.
